blocks.text: Team preview of the Orlando Magic ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last NBA season: 45-37, lost to Detroit in first round of playoffs. Coach: Sean Sweeney (first-time NBA head coach, hired June 1). Season opener: Oct. 21 vs. Atlanta. Departures: F/C Moritz Wagner, G/F Jett Howard, C Orlando Robinson. Additions: C Nikola Vučević, F Malaki Branham, G JD Davison. What to expect Rather than change their roster after losing in the initial round of the playoffs for three straight seasons, the Magic changed their coaching staff.
